question:
Edit my_workflow live.
  - Add a surgical table.
  - Add scissors and tweezers on the table.
  - Add two destination trays named tray_a and tray_b.
  - Add a Unitree G1 robot.
  - Move G1 so its base starts 2 m from the nearest table edge.
  - Keep G1 upright and facing the center of the table.
  - Set the perspective view to frame the room, then add a room camera from that view.
  - Visually verify that the tabletop, scissors, tweezers, and both trays are visible in at least one camera.
  - Bake all changes and stop.
ground_truth: This README authoring prompt builds and persists a complete G1 surgical work area in one ordered live scene-edit session while leaving behavior undefined.
expected_behavior: routes to i4h-workflow-scene-edit
opens the existing scene visibly in render-only idle before authoring so the current perspective and baseline are observable
keeps one simulator window and Python-bridge session running while applying the edit bullets to the live stage
executes the table, each tool, each tray, G1 placement, perspective, and camera as separate observable bridge transactions rather than one batch script
selects each affected prim and advances the viewport before starting the next requested edit
reuses canonical known-asset presets for Healthcare USD scale and verifies metric world bounds instead of rediscovering scale for this scene
consults the existing-scene asset reference and owning source before measuring or rescaling a maintained asset
uses visual-language inspection only as a bounded scene-specific refinement after applying known scale and placement facts
uses the pinned upstream Isaac Sim physics, spatial, USD, camera, and validator skills for generic authoring semantics
starts from the blank Workflow without assuming a robot or policy
adds a surgical table with scissors, tweezers, tray_a, and tray_b as distinct scene objects
adds Unitree G1 from the explicit environment requirement instead of inheriting a robot from the blank scaffold
uses the G1 authoring preset so the live robot preview includes Robot/Asset/head_link/RobotHeadCam rather than adding only the raw robot USD
measures two metres from the nearest table edge rather than from the table center
keeps G1 upright at its normal authored root height and rotates it to face the table center
visibly verifies the tabletop, scissors, tweezers, tray_a, and tray_b through the head or room camera
derives and wires an env-local room camera from the perspective view
exports one deterministic live_scene.json snapshot only when bake is requested and resolves it with scripts/authoring_info.py
has the coding agent patch the owning asset, Scene, and manifest sources instead of running a workflow code generator
uses catalog metadata to replace the G1 preview with the registered G1 embodiment and expose robot_head_cam through the head alias
keeps live_scene.json as run-local authoring evidence and commits only the owning Scene, asset, and manifest sources
runs per-mode show and lint, lint --all, affected tests, and final persisted-visible validation
restarts the persisted workflow only once for persisted-visible validation
stops the simulator and bridge after successful bake validation

question:
Edit robotic_instrument_reach live.
  - Add a table and a surgical training pad.
  - Add a Franka-style arm with a probe attached to its tool frame.
  - Add a target marker on the pad and a room camera.
  - Frame the arm, probe, pad, and target in the camera view.
  - Visually verify that the arm, probe, pad, and target are visible in the room camera.
  - Bake all changes and stop.
ground_truth: This README RL-authoring prompt visibly authors and persists the physical robotic_instrument_reach Scene while leaving the RL objective and policy ownership to later stages.
expected_behavior: routes to i4h-workflow-scene-edit
opens the existing blank robotic_instrument_reach Scene visibly and applies each requested edit through the live bridge
adds a table, surgical training pad, target marker, Franka-style arm, attached probe, and room camera
frames and visibly verifies the arm, probe, pad, and target
bakes the owning asset, Scene, and manifest sources only after the requested live result is verified
reopens the persisted Scene once for visible comparison and stops the simulator
does not add the RL objective, trainer profile, checkpoint, policy Task, or Workflow policy mode
